messages:
elaine-cs: Escalation from FIN customer — after an EU->US failover their responses are garbled (emoji shown as weird chars), some outputs truncated, and frontend saw intermittent 401s. They also reported a billing spike from automatic retries. Need urgent triage.

jordan-se: Ack. Can you paste a minimal request + response (headers + body)?

elaine-cs: Pasting sanitized example we just captured: 

```
# client request
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXXX" \\
  -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-pro-v1.2","input":"Translate: 👍 -> emoji","stream":false}'
```

Response headers we saw: 
```
x-redwood-served-variant: redwood-lite-v0.9-quant
x-redwood-region: us-east-1
x-request-retries: 3
x-forwarded-for: 13.32.11.7
```

Body returned (truncated): "â˜º" instead of "👍" and the rest of the translation got cut off to just "Translate:"

sam-ml: That looks like mojibake from a tokenizer/encoding mismatch — standby quantized variant probably uses a byte-level tokenizer or different vocab, so multi-byte emoji got mangled and special tokens may be missing causing truncation. Also retries + cross-region hops could explain transient 401s if client TTLs expire. Can runtime grab the route trace? :thinking:

runtime-bot: deploy-bot: route-change detected: policy=regional-failover, action=serve-standby-variant(redwood-lite-v0.9-quant), reason=capacity_pressure(us-east-1), trace_id=tr_abc123

jordan-se: If that's the case we should not silently serve an incompatible variant. Short-term mitigations: 1) disable auto-fallback for this tenant, 2) allow clients to request exact-variant by header (X-Prefer-Exact-Variant: true) so we can return an error instead of a bad response, 3) map fallback to compatible family only.

oncall: I can flip tenant-level fallback off for FIN-9823 now. Also can attempt to route them back to eu region if capacity permits — that should restore the original variant (or at least a compatible one).

elaine-cs: Account id FIN-9823. Please patch ASAP; customer is in production and asking for ETA.

billing: Noted — I see token/bandwidth spike for that account starting ~45m ago (x8 request volume). I'll open a billing ticket and request a temporary credit while we investigate.

sam-ml: Repro steps for runtime team: run the curl but force the standby route and compare tokenizers. Example tokenization check: 
```
# tokenization check
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('redwood-pro-v1.2.json'); print(t.encode('👍').tokens)"
```
Expected: utf8-aware token sequence for emoji. Observed on quant variant: byte-like tokens -> re-decoded to mojibake in UTF-8 output. Also run with -H "X-Force-Region: us-east-1" to trigger standby path.

jordan-se: Proposed short-term fix: add a preflight handshake in the routing layer that compares requested model family and tokenizer_vocab_id against the served variant. If mismatch, return 409 with compatibility hint instead of serving incompatible variant. Long-term: add variant metadata (family, tokenizer_id, compatibility flags) and consult compatibility matrix when routing.

runtime-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-456, priority=P1, assignee=@sam-ml (see trace tr_abc123)

oncall: Rolling back standby mapping for FIN-9823 now -> routing flags changed. Monitoring for errors and client confirmation.

elaine-cs: Customer reports partial recovery: emoji fixed for newly served requests, but they still see rare truncated responses and occasional 401s when retries happen.

jordan-se: 401s probably from extra retry latency causing client-side auth token TTL to expire; recommend increasing token TTL for this tenant or advise client to use idempotency/refresh flow. Also add server-side guard to avoid retry storms when fallback occurs.

billing: Billing credit request filed and linked to ticket #BILL-993. I'll hold charges for the spike until we confirm resolution.

sam-ml: Follow-ups (assigned):
- Add tokenizer_compat preflight check as 24h hotfix.
- Add per-tenant admin toggle to disable region-failover (already can but making it quicker).
- Instrument telemetry: log requested_model -> served_variant mapping for every request (bumping priority).

elaine-cs: Thanks — I'll update the customer and keep the thread open until 24h without regressions.

oncall: Alerts configured for FIN-9823. Ping if we need rollback again.

(we'll attach request traces and raw logs to the incident ticket — incoming files include the trace_id above and the captured headers.)
